data_contract.neural: Actual HDF5 metadata shows mTFR/NT and mTFR/T, pin/pout and ipsi/contra/all fields. Full-sensor powspctrm has HDF5 shape [15,200,53,62], corresponding to MATLAB [62 channels,53 frequencies,200 times,15 participants]. Single-region arrays preserve 15 participants. These are physiological time-frequency inputs, not group test statistics.
data_contract.labels: NT=no TMS, T=TMS; pin/pout=target inside/outside phosphene field. Source explicitly lists retained IDs [1,3,5,6,7,10,12,14,15,17,22,23,25,26,27] and aligns sensors by stimulated hemisphere.
data_contract.time_alignment: mTFR time and freq arrays are present. The author figure selects 0.5–2 seconds versus 3–4.5 seconds and 7–20 Hz; a revised endpoint must be frozen separately.
data_contract.split: Pair whole participants across conditions; all days of a person remain together. Trial-level behavioral data can support within-person contrasts, not independent trial-count inference.
data_contract.controls: Pre-TMS baseline, opposite visual hemifield, spatial specificity, blink/ocular contamination, and post-pulse artifact interval. Published processed arrays cannot independently test the original artifact removal.
